package main

import (
	"context"
	"fmt"
	"log"

	_ "github.com/mattn/go-sqlite3"

	"example.com/fabrica/storage-annotations/internal/storage"
	"example.com/fabrica/storage-annotations/internal/storage/ent"
	"example.com/fabrica/storage-annotations/internal/storage/ent/migrate"
)

func initializeStorage(config *Config) (func(), error) {
	client, err := ent.Open("sqlite3", config.DatabaseURL)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("open SQLite: %w", err)
	}
	if err := client.Schema.Create(context.Background(), migrate.WithForeignKeys(true)); err != nil {
		_ = client.Close()
		return nil, fmt.Errorf("migrate SQLite: %w", err)
	}
	storage.SetEntClient(client)
	return func() {
		if err := client.Close(); err != nil {
			log.Printf("close SQLite: %v", err)
		}
	}, nil
}
